who_pays: Mindswarms pays you directly — $10 to $50 per study (sometimes more), sent via PayPal.
who_qualifies: You must qualify for each study based on your profile; it's open worldwide. You need the Mindswarms app on your phone and a PayPal account to receive payment.
work_available: Only when you qualify. Studies arrive as invitations and there is no guaranteed volume — treat it as fast spare cash when it hits, never as reliable income.
what_gets_accepted: A study counts when you record video answers that meet the study's requirements — each study is 1-7 one-minute questions answered selfie-style. A quiet, well-lit spot and a working phone camera are what get your recordings accepted.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Free to join — no fee, and you're paid, not charged. Unpaid time is small: waiting for survey invites and answering the quick qualifying questions before each study. Each completed study takes only 1-7 minutes of your time.
when_cash_arrives: Within 24 hours of completing a study, via PayPal.
